title: A novel Cu(II)-based DNA-intercalating agent: Structural and biological insights using biophysical and in silico techniques.
authors: Movahedi, Elaheh; Razmazma, Hafez; Rezvani, Alireza; Nowroozi, Alireza; Ebrahimi, Ali; Eigner, Vaclav; Dusek, Michal; Arjmand, Farukh
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究一种新型Cu(II)配合物与DNA的嵌入结合，采用光谱实验、DFT、分子对接和QM/MM模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（实为小分子-DNA）且方法可迁移，但非TF-DNA体系，深度有限。
abstract: A new mixed-ligand Cu(II) complex formulated as [Cu(dipic)(amp)(H(2)O)].H(2)O (dipic: pyridine-2,6-dicarboxylic acid, amp: 2-amino-4-methylpyridine), was synthesized and structurally characterized by FTIR spectroscopy, CHN analysis, and the single-crystal X-ray crystallographic method. The complex crystallizes in an orthorhombic space group Pna2(1,) and the coordination environment around the metal center was found to be a pentacoordinate CuN(2)O(2)O(W) distorted square-pyramidal geometry. In order to systematically explore a detailed in vitro and in silico study of the DNA binding of the title complex, various biophysical (UV-Vis absorption spectroscopy, fluorescence, competitive binding with ethidium bromide) and theoretical (DFT, molecular docking simulation, and QM/MM) methods were applied which revealed that the complex could intercalate with the insertion of the amp ligand between the DNA base pairs. The experimental thermodynamic parameters of the interaction revealed the spontaneity of the process and the domination of the hydrophobic interactions in the association and stabilization of the DNA-Cu(II) complex adduct, which was in line with the docking and QM/MM data. In vitro cytotoxic potential of the complex against the human breast adenocarcinoma (MCF-7) cells was examined using MTT assay, which indicated that cancerous cells showed inhibition in presence of the complex.
abstract_zh: 一种新型混合配体Cu(II)配合物，化学式为[Cu(dipic)(amp)(H(2)O)].H(2)O（dipic：吡啶-2,6-二甲酸，amp：2-氨基-4-甲基吡啶），已被合成，并通过FTIR光谱、CHN分析及单晶X射线晶体学方法进行了结构表征。该配合物结晶于正交晶系Pna2(1)空间群，金属中心周围的配位环境为五配位的CuN(2)O(2)O(W)畸变四方锥几何构型。为系统探索该标题配合物DNA结合的详细体外及计算机模拟研究，采用了多种生物物理方法（紫外-可见吸收光谱、荧光、与溴化乙锭的竞争结合）及理论方法（DFT、分子对接模拟和QM/MM），结果表明该配合物可通过amp配体插入DNA碱基对之间进行嵌入结合。相互作用的实验热力学参数揭示了该过程的自发性，以及疏水相互作用在DNA-Cu(II)配合物加合物的缔合和稳定化中占主导地位，这与对接和QM/MM数据一致。通过MTT实验检测了该配合物对人乳腺腺癌（MCF-7）细胞的体外细胞毒性潜力，结果表明在配合物存在下，癌细胞表现出抑制作用。
